title: test(types,core,observability): two-way drift pin on the redact word lists, plus empty-stack and object-carried cause fixtures
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DLCo5F2y7fgbM8tstGoyyUn)_

Fixes #37744

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：用户无感；只改了三个包里日志原因链的测试，运行代码一行未动。
- 为什么做：错误原因链格式化的三份拷贝之间的防走样测试只防删词不防加词，且有两个共用分支没有用例，这次补齐。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是测试误报变红，不影响任何线上行为，可直接撤回。
- 要你做的：无。

## What changes

Test-only, three files; no runtime source line changes (`git diff origin/main --stat -- ':!*.test.ts'` is empty).

**N1, the drift guard is now two-directional.** Each of the three copies is read off its own source file and compared, as a sorted word set, to the hand-copied fixture its package's test already carries:

| Package test | Source it reads | Lists pinned |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `packages/types/src/server-fault-log-cause.test.ts` | `server-fault-log.ts` | `DEFAULT_REDACTED_WORDS`, `CONCATENATED_SECRET_QUALIFIERS` |
| `packages/core/src/logger-error-cause.test.ts` | `logger.ts` | `ObjectLogger`'s default `redact` list (an inline literal, core has no named constant), `CONCATENATED_SECRET_QUALIFIERS` |
| `packages/observability/src/__tests__/loggers.test.ts` | `loggers.ts` | `DEFAULT_REDACTED_WORDS`, `CONCATENATED_SECRET_QUALIFIERS` |

Each extraction also asserts exactly one declaration matched, so a rename or a second declaration reds instead of reading an empty list. A dropped word was already red through the behavioural glued-qualifier fixture; an added word is now red through these.

The card's mechanism assumption that `@objectstack/types` exports a list the other copies could compare against does not hold: none of the three packages exports either list (`grep -n '^export'` over all three files). Exporting one would be a runtime source change, which the card rules out, so each package pins its own copy against its own fixture, reading only files inside its own package (no cross-package test input).

**N2, two shared branches gain fixtures.**
- An `Error` cause with an empty `stack` (the stack-omitted branch of `causeLine`).
- A chain that continues through a non-`Error` object cause that itself carries `cause`.

Both are added to the core parity block (`ObjectLogger` vs `faultCauseChain`) and the observability parity block (`ConsoleLogger` and `JsonLogger` vs `faultCauseChain`). In `@objectstack/types`, `faultCauseChain` is the reference the other blocks compare against, so it gets two direct assertions of its expected output for the same inputs.

- The `causeLine` stack branch made unconditional and `causeOf` limited to `Error` values, in all three copies at once: 15/15, 20/20, 44/44, all green. That is the N2 gap.

## Acceptance notes

- Adding a word to any single copy reds that copy's package test (rows 1 to 6). Both N2 fixtures are green in every parity block and in the direct `faultCauseChain` block, and ablating each branch in any one copy reds its case (rows 7 to 12).
- The three test files still each hand-copy the fixture lists. Changing one source copy together with its own test's fixture, and nothing else, stays green in that package. The guard catches the edit the card names (one word added to one copy, and nothing else). Catching a paired edit would need each package to read a sibling package's source, or a shared exported list, which is a runtime source change. Left as is.
- `@objectstack/types` is CJS-typed, so its test finds the source through `__dirname` rather than `import.meta`, the same constraint `node-isolation.test.ts` documents.

## Verification

Read first: `packages/core/src/logger-error-cause.test.ts`, the new bottom block (regex over the inline `redact` default, the one list with no named constant), then `packages/types/src/server-fault-log-cause.test.ts` (`__dirname` lookup).

Two-minute check: add `'foo',` after `'xsrf',` in `packages/core/src/logger.ts`, then run `pnpm --filter @objectstack/core exec vitest run src/logger-error-cause.test.ts`. Expect 1 failed: `the redact word lists equal the fixture, in both directions > CONCATENATED_SECRET_QUALIFIERS`.
